```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try {
        var inputJson = "{\"bytes\":[90,97,114,110,97,107],\"filename\":\"external-findings-invalid.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}";
        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extractWithExternalRedaction(input, config, java.util.Arrays.asList(JsonUtil.fromJson("{\"label\":\"inspection_person\",\"score\":0.99,\"text\":\"Zarnak\"}", ExternalRedactionFinding.class)), "bytes-ish", 8);
        System.out.println(result);
        } catch (XbergRsException error) {
            System.err.println(error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + error.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```
